contract.ap: 101-point interpolated AP at IoU 0.5; mAP excludes zero-support classes
contract.matching: class-aware one-to-one IoU matching per view; predictions globally ranked by score within class with deterministic view/index ties
contract.metric_aggregation: micro P/R/F1 across classes; macro AP50 across supported classes
contract.size_basis: original source-image bbox area in pixels squared
contract.size_matching: non-overlapping half-open bins; detections matched to out-of-bin truth and unmatched detections outside the bin are ignored for that bin

selection_boundary.purpose: frozen-validation diagnosis and next-run gate design
